content_of_post_to_comment:
How do you stay consistent with working out?

I have the internal motivation to want to be healthy and be consistent, and I’m able to be consistent for 2-3 weeks, but after that, I find it really hard to stay consistent. What works for you?
comment: I used to hit that same 2-3 week wall because I treated motivation like it was supposed to carry me forever. What helped was making the habit almost too easy to fail: short workouts on busy days, a set schedule, and focusing on showing up instead of crushing every session. Consistency got easier when missing a day stopped feeling like starting over.
